0022600112.text: The Utah Jazz (1-1, 9th in the West) host the Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, 1st in the West) in the Jazz's third game of the 2026-27 season, coming off a win and without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Lakers, who are 1st in the Pacific and on a two-game winning streak, will be missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost 0-4 in the series, most recently 131-107 in Los Angeles on April 12.
